# Allowlist for `dart run tool/check_dead_code.dart` (see tool/check_dead_code.dart).
#
# Format: one `<path relative to repo root>:<Name>` per line for top-level
# declarations, or `<path>:<Class>.<member>` for members. `#` starts a comment.
#
# Every entry needs a justification comment. Prefer deleting dead code, or
# marking a deliberate test seam with `@visibleForTesting` (the tool skips
# those). Entries that stop being findings fail the check, so remove them when
# the declaration is deleted or starts being referenced from lib/.
